verdict.rationale: LangGraph is an orchestration framework with an associated deployment and tracing platform (LangSmith), so a training-data opt-out or no-training policy is a fair question. Nothing in the evidence pack addresses whether user data is excluded from AI model training. Self-hosted persistence, such as a Postgres-backed checkpointer, is a deployment detail, not a documented training-data protection, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
